_comment: How capable each model is, and the least capable model each role may run
on (IDE-152). Data, not code: a new model is a row here, never a branch.
The floor exists because a mistake in an ADR or a plan multiplies into
every PBI cut from it. The live ADO run of 2026-10-14 put a flash model on
`design`; it pinned a witness that did not parse, and a worker found out
forty-five minutes later. A model this table does not know is below every
floor above `fast`: a new model reaches design or review only after
`models` is looked up first, by the exact `agent[:model]` entry; then
`patterns`, in order, first match wins (shell-style `*`). An entry without
